[[File:Wind_crystal.png|thumb|right]]
'''Wind-crystal''', or '''wind crystal''', was a type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref> On [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], it was used to make luxurious chandeliers.<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> Extremely thin, yet very strong, Wind-crystal would vibrate in the slightest breeze, causing a pleasant sounding humming.<ref name="Traitor" />
